transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Mostly I’m here because I’m just really tired, in a way that sleep doesn’t seem to fix. Even small things, like unloading the dishwasher or trying to read for my certificate class, can feel like too much.
When you wake up in the morning, do you usually feel refreshed?
No, not really. Even when I sleep, I wake up still feeling tired, like I didn’t really recover. It makes little things feel harder than they should.
Has anyone ever told you that you snore loudly?
I don’t think so. No one’s really mentioned loud snoring to me, at least not that I can remember.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
I’m not really sure I’d call it depressed. I’ve felt worn down and kind of low at times, but mostly it’s been the tiredness.
Do you have trouble staying asleep at night?
I’m not really sure. I do wake up feeling tired, but I haven’t paid close attention to whether I’m actually waking up a lot during the night.
Have you been feeling worried or anxious most days?
I’m not sure. I wouldn’t say I feel worried most days, at least not that I’ve really noticed. Mostly I’ve just been trying to get through things.
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I think so. I’ve kind of stopped caring about the things I usually enjoy, like sketching or cooking. Even going to gallery openings, yoga, or playing tennis with a friend just doesn’t really appeal to me much lately.
Have you been feeling sad or down most days?
I’m not really sure. I wouldn’t say I feel sad most days, exactly… maybe just kind of flat or off, but I haven’t been tracking it closely.
Have you noticed a change in your appetite lately?

Yeah, my appetite’s been kind of off. Some days I’ll realize I’ve basically only had coffee and a few bites of something. And my jeans are fitting looser, even though I haven’t been trying to lose weight.
Did these changes start after a particular stressful event or major life change?
Yeah… I think it started around when things with my spouse got a lot more tense. The arguments became much more frequent, and this whole pattern has been going on for about four months now.
Has this been making it hard for you to function at work, school, or at home?

Yeah, it has. I’ve fallen behind in my certificate coursework, and at home I keep letting things pile up—bills, meals, basic household stuff. I make plans, but I just don’t stay organized or follow through very well. My spouse has had to pick up more of it, and I’ve also kind of pulled back from friends and some art commitments I usually care about.
When things with your spouse feel less tense, do your low energy and loss of interest ease up?

Not really. Even when things are a little calmer, I’m still just tired in this way that sleep doesn’t really fix. Like unloading the dishwasher or trying to read for my certificate class can feel like too much.
Before this period, have you ever had another time in your life when you felt this same kind of loss of interest and low energy for a couple of weeks or longer?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of another time that felt quite like this for that long, but I may just not be remembering clearly.
Over the past month, have you felt down or depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I’m not sure I’d say nearly every day. I’ve had some days where I feel pretty low, but I haven’t really been tracking whether it’s most of the day or that often.
In the past two weeks, have you felt down, depressed, or hopeless on most days?
I’m not totally sure. I’ve had days where I feel pretty down, but I don’t know if it’s been most days in the last two weeks.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt down or depressed on more days than not?
I don’t really know. I’ve felt down some days, but I haven’t kept track closely enough to say it’s been more days than not.
During the past two weeks, have you felt sad, empty, or hopeless for most of the day nearly every day?
I don’t think I can say that. I’ve felt sad or kind of empty at times, but I’m not sure it’s been most of the day almost every day.
In the past two weeks, have you felt little pleasure in things you usually enjoy on most days?

Yeah, I think so. I’ve kind of stopped caring about things I usually enjoy—like sketching, cooking, yoga, going to gallery openings, even playing tennis with a friend. I just don’t feel much interest in them lately.
Before this started, was there ever a period in your life when you lost interest in most things for at least two weeks?

Yes, there has been a time like that before. I stopped caring about the things that usually make me feel like myself—sketching, going to gallery openings, cooking, yoga, even playing tennis with a friend. It went on long enough that it wasn’t just a bad day or two.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt sad, down, or hopeless nearly every day?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had moments where I feel down, but I don’t think I’d say it’s been nearly every day.

A full major depressive symptom count is only partially established because depressed mood was not clearly confirmed, so the least specific depressive episode code is most supportable among the options.
